demographics.strict_backtest_decision: Exclude demographic blocks until historical releases are reconstructed
demographics.source: World Bank WDI, UN Population Division World Population Prospects
features: 65+ percent of total de facto resident population
demographics.denominator_note: Separate, explicitly named denominators; neither is the registered electorate. Female20-24 and25-29 shares can be summed within female population. Do not multiply by the collected female-total weight: its metadata additionally cites WPP2022, so cross-series vintage alignment is not certified.
demographics.reference_rule: Exact election-year minus2, capped at2022; no interpolation, no nearest future year, no2024/2025 values or population forecasts. Cap makes current inputs deliberately stale; not an availability certificate.
demographics.omitted: CBS locality age/sex/SES lacks compatible national historical coverage and verified release vintages; locality medians/ranks are not averaged. Male/female-total WB series retained as audit material, not fitted. No individual voter inference.

conflicts.definition: Non-exhaustive curated named-onset index: E014 six wars and four Gaza operations, plus three onsets directly checked in E016. No claim of complete conflict coverage or peace when the index is zero.
features: count of catalogued onsets in365 days through forecast cutoff
years since latest catalogued onset, capped at10
conflicts.strict_backtest_decision: Retrospective event-date sensitivity; source pages are later publications, not archived real-time versions
conflicts.unknown_end_rule: End/active status/severity are not inferred or fitted. Unknown ends remain null. No current conflict prediction: post2022 catalogue incomplete.

additional_events.label: Operation Accountability
additional_events.note: Page has inconsistent40-day evacuation narrative versus six-day duration; use explicitly dated onset only.

conflicts.effect_interpretation: Predictive association only; outcome-inspected history, era and demographic trends confound effects. Narrow catalogue chosen before E016 model execution, not claimed exhaustive.

history.usage: Earlier numerical outcomes only; original publication vintages not reconstructed, as E014/E015

scope: Audit timebox narrowed broad demographic/conflict proposal to two compatible age context measures and onset sensitivity. Historical/economic/severity expansion not silently invented. No forecast adoption.
